about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-84, part of the addendum XC-79 to XC-84 drafted on 2026-10-25. It extends the 'cover ALL' decomposition proposed as XC-54 to XC-78 (pull request #80) without changing any of its files. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. It becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub, after XC-51 to XC-53 and XC-54 to XC-78. Every criterion except scope, pushed and the unchanged-suite guards fails on today's tree and passes only on committed evidence. Evidence is testnet-only, loopback-only and verify-only unless the task says otherwise; hosted facilitators are never called. Estimated effort: 1 days.

not_contract_tasks.keys: Throwaway testnet keys and faucet tokens are created on the owner's machine and live in X402C_KEYS outside the repository. No spend, no mainnet.
not_contract_tasks.disclosure: A failing third-party column is reported to that project privately first (SECURITY.md). Until the window clears its row says 'under disclosure' with no per-check detail.

tasks.title: Yank x402-conformance 1.3.0 and 1.3.1 on PyPI, with a reason pointing to 1.4.0

on_lapse: reassign to the next free agent

tasks.description: 1.3.0 and 1.3.1 are superseded. The owner approved yanking both (not deleting) on 2026-10-23, with the reason 'superseded by 1.4.0'. PyPI offers yanking only in its web interface, so the owner does it himself in his PyPI session; no agent holds the PyPI login. The evidence is a committed record of the PyPI JSON API for both versions after the yank, and RELEASES.md notes it.
tasks.evidence_required: The merged PR, the CI run on main where every criterion passes, and the committed evidence named in the criteria. No link, no done.

criteria.statement: The committed record shows 1.3.0 and 1.3.1 yanked with the reason, read from the PyPI JSON API after the yank

verifier.cmd: python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('evidence/registry/pypi-yank-1.3.json'));v={x['version']:x for x in d['versions']};sys.exit(0 if all(v.get(k,{}).get('yanked') is True and 'superseded by 1.4.0' in v[k].get('yanked_reason','') and v[k].get('source','').startswith('https://pypi.org/pypi/x402-conformance/') for k in ('1.3.0','1.3.1')) else 1)"

criteria.statement: PyPI still shows both versions yanked

verifier.cmd: python3 -c "import json,sys,urllib.request as u;sys.exit(0 if all(json.load(u.urlopen('https://pypi.org/pypi/x402-conformance/%s/json'%k,timeout=30))['info']['yanked'] for k in ('1.3.0','1.3.1')) else 1)"

criteria.statement: Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.
Yank, never delete. Only the owner acts on PyPI, in his own session.
